text: “不！”查理尖叫道，“伟大的风行者来了！”她抓起步枪，指着你和几名研究生，眼神狂乱地向河边退去。
“白人永远不懂。”她啐了一口，“那你们就去吧。跟风行者走！”她跑向破损的独木舟，拿起自己的背包，冲进树林。
你在她身后大喊，试图以专业态度劝她留下，但她没有回来。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 61
text: “No!” Charlie screams. “The Great Wind-Walker comes!” She grabs her rifle and levels it at you and the graduate students. Eyes wild, she backs toward the river.
“White men never understand,” she spits. “Go, then. Go with the Wind-Walker!” She runs to the ruined canoe, takes her personal pack, and dashes into the forest.
You shout after her, appealing to her professionalism. But she does not return.
